jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.snippet: Design and deploy intelligent AI agents at Optiver Sydney, owning the full lifecycle from prototyping to production, with a focus on impactful business outcomes.
jobs.description:
## About Optiver

Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam in 1986, with offices in Sydney, London, Chicago, Amsterdam, Hong Kong, and Singapore. The Sydney office is one of Optiver's primary locations for Asia-Pacific markets, trading a range of products across equities, options, and fixed income.

## About the Role

As an AI Engineer at Optiver Sydney, you will design and deploy intelligent AI agents that drive real business outcomes. You'll own the full lifecycle — from prototyping and experimentation through to production deployment — with a strong emphasis on impact measurement and iteration. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, and quantitative problem-solving.

## Responsibilities

- Build and deploy AI agent systems in a high-performance trading environment
- Pair-programme on agentic workflows and develop AI solutions using modern LLM and orchestration frameworks
- Collaborate with quants, traders, and software engineers to identify and solve business problems
- Manage the full ML lifecycle: data exploration, model development, deployment, and monitoring
- Design scalable architectures for AI workflows and agentic pipelines

## Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
- Strong Python expertise with production software engineering skills
- Familiarity with LLM frameworks, agent orchestration (LangGraph, DSPy, etc.), and RAG pipelines
- Experience shipping production AI systems in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Interest in financial markets; prior finance knowledge is not required

## Tech Stack

Python, LLM frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph/DSPy), cloud ML platforms, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines

## Benefits

- Highly competitive remuneration
- Breakfast, lunch, and in-house barista at Sydney HQ
- Gym membership and chair massages
- Professional development and mentorship
- Collaborative, high-performance culture

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Engineer
jobs.snippet: Join a pivotal AI initiative at Optiver Sydney, driving ML infrastructure, training, and inference challenges to advance futures trading strategies.
jobs.description:
## About Optiver

Optiver is a technology-driven global market maker powering millions of trades a day. The ML Research team at Optiver advances the state of the art in applied machine learning for quantitative finance, working alongside world-class researchers and engineers.

## About the Role

Joining a pivotal AI initiative, the Machine Learning Research Engineer will drive ML infrastructure, training, and inference challenges that underpin Optiver's trading strategies. You'll work closely with quantitative researchers and traders on new ML experiments, capabilities, and data sources, and have the opportunity to blend your own development expertise with the best open-source frameworks and tools.

## Responsibilities

- Design and implement improvements to ML training and inference pipelines at massive scale
- Optimise researcher productivity through tooling and infrastructure improvements
- Collaborate on integrating deep learning models into live trading systems
- Contribute to internal ML frameworks and keep pace with the frontier of ML research
- Tackle core ML infrastructure, training, and inference challenges

## Requirements

- Strong publication record at top ML venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, or similar)
- Deep expertise in PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow internals
- Experience with large-scale distributed training and model optimisation
- Solid Python and C++ engineering skills
- PhD or equivalent research experience in Machine Learning or related field
- Interest in quantitative finance applications

## Tech Stack

PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow, CUDA, distributed training frameworks, Python, C++

## Benefits

- Highly competitive salary and profit-sharing
- Professional development budget and conference travel
- Flexible working arrangements
- Sydney CBD office with outstanding amenities

jobs.title: Graduate Machine Learning Modelling Engineer

jobs.description:
## About Optiver

Optiver is a global electronic market maker where graduates take on real ownership and impact from day one. The Sydney office is a key hub for Asia-Pacific markets, housing world-class researchers, engineers, and traders.

## About the Role

As a Graduate ML Modelling Engineer, you will work alongside experienced researchers and engineers to build and iterate on ML models that inform Optiver's trading strategies. By the end of your first year, you'll have a clear and practical understanding of how ML techniques are applied in the quantitative trading industry.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain machine learning models for quantitative trading strategies
- Collaborate with quants on backtesting, model evaluation, and iteration
- Contribute to compute platforms supporting large-scale ML training workloads
- Apply modern ML techniques to real quantitative trading problems
- Build and enhance data pipelines for model development

## Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or related quantitative field
- Strong foundation in Machine Learning fundamentals (optimisation, deep learning, statistics)
- Proficiency in Python; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow is a plus
- Graduating 2026 or early 2027 with Australian or New Zealand working rights
- Team player with genuine interest in quantitative finance (prior finance knowledge not required)

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, NumPy/pandas, distributed computing

## Benefits

- Highly competitive graduate remuneration package
- Structured mentorship and Optiver-provided training program
- Collaborative, intellectually stimulating team culture
- Catered daily meals and wellbeing benefits

jobs.description:
## 关于明汯投资

明汯投资是中国顶级量化私募之一，成立于2014年，管理规模超千亿元，专注于大数据与AI驱动的量化投资策略研究。在上海、北京、香港均设有办公室，团队汇聚国内外顶尖高校的技术与研究人才。

## 岗位职责

- 研究并实现先进的机器学习与深度学习算法，并将其应用于量化投资场景
- 参与量化因子挖掘、选股模型及策略开发
- 利用大数据技术处理海量金融市场数据，构建特征工程流水线
- 配合研究员完成模型回测、优化、验证及上线
- 跟踪学术前沿（NeurIPS、ICML等顶会成果）并探索在量化领域的应用

## 任职要求

- 在读本科/硕士/博士，计算机、数学、统计、物理、金融工程等STEM方向
- 扎实的机器学习基础，熟悉Python（numpy/pandas/scikit-learn/PyTorch）
- 具备良好的数学功底（线性代数、概率统计、优化理论）
- 热爱量化投资，对AI在金融领域的应用有浓厚兴趣
- 实习周期至少3个月，每周至少4天到岗（上海/北京均可）

## 薪资待遇

- 日薪300–500元（根据水平面议）
- 优秀实习生可获得转正机会
- 完善的导师制度与培训体系
- 定期团建与技术分享

## 关于明汯投资

明汯投资是业内领先的量化私募基金，连续多年业绩名列前茅。技术团队由来自MIT、CMU、Caltech等顶尖高校的博士及研究人员组成，持续在AI、大数据、量化金融三个维度深耕。

## 岗位职责

- 独立研究前沿AI/ML算法并将其落地于量化投资实践
- 主导大模型、强化学习、图神经网络等新方法在金融场景中的探索与应用
- 构建高质量量化因子与预测模型，不断优化组合收益风险特征
- 与交易、研究团队深度协作，推进策略从研究到上线的全链路落地

## 任职要求

- 顶尖高校计算机、数学、统计、物理或金融工程专业本科及以上，2026届毕业
- 扎实的算法基础与机器学习理论知识
- 熟练掌握Python/C++编程
- 有顶会论文（NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR等）或量化研究项目经验者优先
- 对量化金融有浓厚兴趣与深度思考

## 薪资待遇

- 极具竞争力的全职年薪（面议）
- 年度绩效奖金
- 六险一金+补充医疗

jobs.title: AI算法研究员（梧桐计划）
jobs.snippet: 九坤投资梧桐计划，为量化业务全链路培养顶尖AI算法人才，年薪百万起，聚焦深度学习与大模型在量化交易中的创新应用。
jobs.description:
## 关于九坤投资

九坤投资（Ubiquant）成立于2012年，是中国规模最大的量化私募之一，旗下设有数据实验室、AI实验室（iQuestLab）和水滴实验室，在大数据驱动的策略研究方面处于行业领先地位。2026年初，九坤AI研究院发布了高效开源大模型iQuest-Coder-V1，展现出深厚的AI研发实力。

## 梧桐计划简介

梧桐计划是九坤面向顶尖应届毕业生的专项人才培养项目，涵盖AI算法研究、量化实现等核心方向，设有明确的成长通道和极具竞争力的薪资待遇（年薪百万量级），并同步开放向优秀候选人内推。

## 岗位职责

- 研究深度学习、强化学习等前沿AI技术并应用于量化策略开发
- 参与LLM、多模态、图神经网络等新方法在金融场景中的探索
- 与交易和研究团队深度合作，推动策略从实验室到生产的全链路落地
- 构建并优化高性能量化AI模型，提升策略超额收益

## 任职要求

- 顶尖高校（含海外知名高校）计算机、数学、统计、物理等专业本硕博
- 扎实的算法与机器学习理论基础
- 熟练Python/C++编程；具备ML框架（PyTorch等）使用经验
- 有竞赛获奖（ACM/ICPC、Kaggle Top等）或顶会论文者优先

## 岗位职责

- 参与贷前准入、贷中审核、贷后监测等全流程AI风控模型的开发与优化
- 基于海量金融行为数据进行特征工程，构建欺诈识别、信用评分等核心模型

- 配合研究员完成模型实验、A/B测试和上线验收

## 任职要求

- 统计学、计算机、数学、金融工程等相关专业在读本硕博，2027届及以后毕业
- 熟悉Python机器学习常用框架（scikit-learn、XGBoost、LightGBM、PyTorch等）
- 有金融数据分析或量化风控实习经历者优先

## 薪资待遇

## 任职要求

- 计算机、数学、统计、金融工程等相关专业硕士及以上，知名高校背景

- 构建端到端的AI实验自动化管线，实现科研工作流的智能化
- 与实验科学家、计算化学团队协作，迭代优化模型性能

## 任职要求

- 计算机、AI/ML、应用数学、计算化学或相关STEM专业本科及以上
- 掌握Python及主流深度学习框架（PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow）
- 有图神经网络（GNN）、分子生成、蛋白质结构预测等方向经验者优先

- 2026届及以后毕业，或有丰富相关工作经验

上海（张江）、深圳、北京（多地同步招聘）

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Products
jobs.description: Singtel/Optus is looking for an AI Product Manager to support the development and delivery of AI products within their Customer, Enabling, or Technology product portfolios. Reporting to the Senior Director of AI Product, you'll be accountable for supporting product strategy execution and roadmap delivery for a single AI product or squad, aligned to Optus.ai objectives and business goals. Responsibilities include contributing to product backlogs by writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria that translate business requirements into actionable development work, conducting user research initiatives including interviews, surveys, usability testing, and behavioural analysis to understand user needs and validate solutions, and collaborating with cross-functional squads including engineering, data science, design, and business stakeholders through the product development lifecycle. Required qualifications include demonstrated experience supporting product development from concept to launch, proficiency in product analytics and using data insights to drive product decisions, and understanding of AI/ML concepts and ability to work effectively with technical teams.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist - Agentic AI
jobs.description: As the Lead Data Scientist at Macquarie Asset Management, you will partner with business leaders, engineering, and cross-functional teams to architect the future of AI and data science, owning the end-to-end strategy, influencing executive and board-level decisions, and shaping how AI transforms the business. You will lead, inspire, and grow a high-performing global team, fostering technical excellence, diversity of thought, and a culture of ambitious experimentation. Leveraging modern platforms, you will pioneer production-grade agentic AI and digital co-worker capabilities by harnessing advanced machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs) to solve complex challenges and drive innovation across investment management, client servicing, fund management, and corporate operations. Key requirements include experience with Agentic AI platforms, familiarity with Google Gemini and the Agent Development Kit (ADK), proven track record of implementing data science and AI solutions with measurable ROI, and relevant tertiary qualification (Master's or Doctorate preferred) in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or Computer Science.

jobs.title: AI Native Platform Engineer
jobs.description: As a junior member of the AI SDLC Developer Productivity and Enablement team, you will help build and maintain the SCM, CI/CD pipelines, and developer productivity tooling that engineering teams rely on daily, and contribute to maintaining the organisation's GitHub Actions runner fleet, developing reusable workflows, and ensuring internal integrations work seamlessly for business application teams.
